GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Blundered on jumping and travelled wide and without cover for the majority of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped evenly. Rolled fwd & raced 3rd 3 Wide No Cover (2L from lead) early . Stayed same until pushed out Four Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured @ 200m & faded in last 100m. # Wide & faded.
